title: Sable and the Extraction
author: Sable Reyes
blurb: Silas Delacroix, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
